evidence.note: The only producer gates stagedDeletion on staged (empty deletion list when !staged) and returns absent before computing the other bits when !present, so stagedDeletion implies staged and absence is a prior phase.

notes: Bits collapse to PortfolioIndexPublishDisposition absent|current|regenerated|removed|drifted. Producer emits present=false; present+!staged+!stagedDeletion; present+staged+!stagedDeletion; present+staged+stagedDeletion.
